name: abs-edge-cache
description: Cloudflare Worker + R2 + HTTP/3 (QUIC) edge caching front door for Audiobookshelf with an automatic Free-Tier Circuit Breaker.

ORIGIN.description: Full base URL of your Audiobookshelf origin server (e.g., https://abs-origin.example.com).

FREE_TIER_GUARD.description: Set to 'yes' to enforce 9.0 GB R2 storage and monthly Class A/B free-tier limits, or 'no' for paid R2.

WARM_WINDOW_TRACKS.description: Number of chapters/tracks to warm ahead in a sliding window for multi-file audiobooks (0 = warm entire book).

VERIFY_JWT.description: Set to 'yes' (with JWT_SECRET) to verify Audiobookshelf HS256 JWT signatures at the edge.
